verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a public API across tenant and environment endpoints, with a single unified API for all payment methods and countries. The docs cover direct API integration, JWS request signing, structured JSON error codes, capture endpoints, a sandbox with an interactive API Reference, and an llms.txt with agent instructions, so the API can be driven programmatically. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
